mapper.select: select c.id, c.course_name as courseName, c.teacher_id as teacherId, c.credit, c.capacity, c.selected_count as selectedCount, u.real_name as teacherName from course_selection cs inner join course c on cs.course_id = c.id left join `user` u on c.teacher_id = u.id where cs.student_id = #{studentId} order by cs.id desc

select cs.id, cs.student_id as studentId, cs.course_id as courseId, cs.select_time as selectTime, u.username as studentUsername, u.real_name as studentName, u.class_name as className, s.score as score from course_selection cs inner join `user` u on cs.student_id = u.id left join score s on s.student_id = cs.student_id and s.course_id = cs.course_id where cs.course_id = #{courseId} order by u.username

select distinct u.id as studentId, u.username as studentUsername, u.real_name as studentName, u.class_name as className from course_selection cs inner join course c on cs.course_id = c.id inner join `user` u on cs.student_id = u.id where c.teacher_id = #{teacherId} order by u.username
